summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital (NYSE: PLGO), a Bermuda foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing board approval of a replenished common share repurchase authorization totaling $400.0 million. The board also raised the quarterly dividend to $0.22 per share, payable December 23, 2026, to holders of record December 11, 2026. No advisors or board recommendation language beyond board approval was named. Repurchases may occur via Rule 10b-18 open-market purchases, accelerated share repurchases, privately negotiated transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 plans, at company discretion. Watch buyback execution pace, dividend sustainability, and capital deployment versus growth.
